title: Core Brand Elements
slide_intent: Identify the few repeatable recognition cues so designers understand which elements carry continuity.
strategic_value: The logo, T-Digit, magenta and mnemonic can connect T-Mobile encounters across visual and audio media.
demonstration: A large wordmark sits above three labeled specimens: the T-Digit, a magenta swatch and a sound waveform.
practical_value: Check whether a composition uses an appropriate core cue before adding supporting treatments.
